# aether_organization_member (Resource)

A member of the provider's organization. The API creates the membership only. The address must already have an Aether login account (created through the portal invitation flow; aether-api #302), otherwise the member cannot sign in. Destroying the resource removes the membership and leaves the login account in place. There is no in-place update: changing `email` or `role` replaces the membership (it is removed, then created again with a new `id`). Do not set `create_before_destroy`: the new membership would be created while the old one still holds the address, which the API refuses (409). Member emails are compared case-insensitively: adding an address that differs from an existing member's only in letter case is refused (409). Removing or replacing the organization's last `owner` is refused, because nobody could change roles or delete the organization afterwards. The provider checks the member's current role before sending the removal, serialised within a single run; the API also refuses to remove the last owner (409 `last_owner`), which covers a concurrent removal in the portal or another run. An API token is not tied to the member who created it: after removing an owner (or replacing their membership with a lower role), revoke the API tokens they created in the portal (**Settings → API Tokens**). Transferring ownership takes two applies: add the new owner first, then demote or remove the old one in a second apply. Doing both in a single apply is refused by the last-owner guard or depends on the order in which Terraform happens to run the two changes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The address must already have an Aether login (portal invitation flow).
# Changing role REPLACES the membership; the last owner cannot be removed.
# Write the email in lower case; the API compares member emails case-insensitively.
# After removing an owner, revoke the API tokens they created (portal).
resource "aether_organization_member" "ops" {
  email = "ops@example.com"
  role  = "admin"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Login email address of the member, written in lower case (the canonical form the provider manages). The API compares member emails case-insensitively, so an address that differs from an existing member's only in letter case is refused (409). Changing it replaces the membership.
- `role` (String) One of `owner`, `admin`, `member`, `viewer`. Changing it replaces the membership: a DELETE followed by a POST, which gives the membership a new `id`. The portal never offers `owner`. An `owner` can be demoted from Terraform like any other role; only the last owner is protected, and removing or replacing it is refused.

### Read-Only

- `accepted_at` (String) Time the invitation was accepted (RFC 3339). Always null for a membership created through the API.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time of the membership (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Membership UUID (not a user id). It changes when the membership is replaced.
- `invited_by` (String) UUID of the user who invited the member. Always null for a membership created through the API.
